description: Registry of cross-template distribution skills — capabilities useful across multiple templates (content generation, document parsing, channel adapters, etc.). Each entry maps a skill name to its install source. `claw skill add <name>` consults this registry alongside the foundation registry and the active template's vendor registry.

_status_values.community: Third-party, conforms to documented interface but maintained independently
_status_values.deprecated: Still installable but no longer recommended; see `replaced_by`

_source_schemes.claw: claw:<source-company>/<skill-name> — pulls from a local claw company's workspace (legacy / dev-iteration path)

anygen.description: AI-powered content creation suite — slides/PPT, documents, diagrams, websites, data visualizations, research reports, storybooks, financial analysis, images. Submitter-driven (returns task_id for async fetch).
anygen.notes: Pairs naturally with technical-communication competency's TC-9 (async-tool handoff rule) — surface the task_id, set the wait expectation, don't substitute hand-rolled output.

doc-parse.description: Document parsing (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) via AnyGen's parser endpoints. Use when user needs content extracted from binary documents before reasoning over them.
doc-parse.notes: Requires the same ANYGEN_API_KEY as anygen. Often paired in deployments that need both content-in and content-out.
